description: Engine setup of map1_s06 (School - 1F and basement after the boss), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type SC, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: SplitHead). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: split_head (Split Head's saliva and the shove it gives Harry). A mod changes it with its own maps/map1_s06/overlay.json.
